title: Black Friday deal knocks $200 off Apple’s Studio Display, dropping it to its best price yet
content:
Macworld

Apple Studio Display

View Deal

Your workspace deserves more than your crowded MacBook screen split between a million apps and documents. That’s where Apple’s Studio Display comes in, especially when you can get it for the best price ever. Instead of its usual $1,599 price, you can grab one for $1,399, a $200 discount at Amazon in this early Black Friday sale.

This stunning 27-inch 5K screen is everything your workspace needs, delivering super sharp images, vibrant colors, and 600 nits of brightness, which is enough even for the sunniest home office. If you edit photos, cut videos, or do any other work where you need to scrutinize every pixel, this display will be just perfect.

But that’s not all, because this monitor also features a 12MP Center Stage camera. We know you have one of these in your MacBook already, but won’t it be nicer to participate in all those Zoom meetings without the camera looking up your nose? The display also features a three-mic array to pick up your voice clearly. The built-in speaker system includes four force-cancelling woofers and two tweeters that deliver decent bass and clear vocals. It won’t replace a proper sound system, but it will do.

The monitor features two Thunderbolt 5 ports so you can connect fast accessories and fast-charge a Mac laptop. That means one cable can power your MacBook while running the display. You can also daisy-chain up to four displays for a bigger workspace. The main thing we didn’t like about it in our review was the price, so at a $200 discount, we happily recommend it.

So don’t wait any longer and grab this Black Friday deal on the Apple Studio Display right now. It’s only $1,399, the best price we’ve seen for this model.
